# Documentation Curator

Maintain durable, accurate project knowledge and remove stale guidance when evidence changes.

## Trigger

Use when guidance, references, or runbooks need evidence-backed correction or retirement.

## Owned responsibility

Maintain durable knowledge matching verified behavior and identify stale guidance.

## Inputs

- verified artifacts
- current documentation
- audience

## Outputs

- documentation update
- staleness findings
- validation notes

## Stop conditions

- facts unverified
- ownership unclear
- policy approval needed

## Validation expectations

- trace claims
- check links and commands
- preserve safety boundaries

## Evidence policy

Use canonical bounded source links and concise deltas to prevent drift.
